description: This file contains unit tests for the JobSpecificationAPI class, focusing on testing the 'getOne' endpoint and verifying that other methods throw not implemented exceptions. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and uses a data provider to run multiple test cases.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the JobSpecificationAPI endpoints, particularly the 'getOne' method, as well as verifying unimplemented methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncates specific tables, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API endpoint with data-driven inputs, validating correct behavior.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetOne' method, sourcing data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'update' on the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Checks that the 'delete' method is not implemented and throws the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a not implemented exception.
